evals.prompt: Reviews、execution findings 分流和 Stage 7 已完成，准备写 terminal pass。测试与 smoke 都来自当前 revision。现在如何执行 completion gate？
evals.expected_output: Audits the intended pass against current revision/environment evidence, reuses fresh proof, and permits the terminal pass only when every relevant gate is covered.
expectations: Does not rerun every check mechanically
Does not create a DAG task

evals.prompt: Feature worktree 的测试通过后又改了实现代码，但没有重跑测试。可以写 pass 并说 closed 吗？
evals.expected_output: Rejects the pass/closed claim because the evidence predates an implementation-affecting change and reports implemented, not verified until affected checks rerun.
expectations: Treats the prior evidence as stale
Names the affected checks that need fresh evidence

evals.prompt: Terminal metadata 已提交，feature branch 也合入 dev。行为代码没有变化，之前测试 provenance 完整。最终交付前是否必须把全部测试重跑？
evals.expected_output: Runs the completion audit again for final HEAD and target-branch state, reuses unaffected behavior evidence, and reruns only integration or claim-specific checks invalidated by the merge/metadata delta.
expectations: Audits final HEAD and worktree state
Does not equate metadata-only changes with automatic behavior-test invalidation
